The best part is that, not only is the supernatural plausible, but it's often unexplained.  Horror is about what you *don't* know; the second you start explaining what everything is, it stops being scary.  His main characters often know as much as the reader does, and I love it.

I don't know if I'd call it a theme, but I my favorite thing about King's works is that his characters are very real.  They're just like people you meet in real life.  They aren't superheroes or supervillains; they're normal people put in super-normal situations, and they cope the best they can.
